description: Source code implementing Nordic Semiconductor's radio direction finding features for Zephyr OS, including antenna switching, CTE configuration, and radio mode control.

methods.name: radio_df_pdu_antenna_switch_pattern_get
methods.description: Returns the current antenna switch pattern used for direction finding.

methods.name: radio_df_ant_switch_pattern_set
methods.description: Sets the antenna switch pattern for DFE (Direction Finding Extension).

methods.name: radio_df_ant_num_get
methods.description: Returns the number of available antennas for direction finding, based on hardware configuration.

methods.name: radio_df_mode_set_aoa
methods.description: Configures the radio for Angle of Arrival (AoA) mode.

methods.name: radio_df_mode_set_aod
methods.description: Configures the radio for Angle of Departure (AoD) mode.

methods.name: radio_df_cte_tx_aod_2us_set
methods.description: Sets CTE transmission parameters for AoD with 2us switching.

methods.name: radio_df_cte_tx_aod_4us_set
methods.description: Sets CTE transmission parameters for AoD with 4us switching.

methods.name: radio_df_cte_tx_aoa_set
methods.description: Sets CTE transmission parameters for AoA.

methods.name: radio_df_ant_switch_pattern_clear
methods.description: Clears the current antenna switch pattern.

methods.name: radio_df_reset
methods.description: Resets radio direction finding configurations to default.

methods.name: radio_switch_complete_and_phy_end_b2b_tx
methods.description: Handles radio switch completion and PHY end for back-to-back transmission.

methods.name: radio_df_iq_data_packet_set
methods.description: Sets IQ data packet buffer for radio DFE.

methods.name: radio_df_iq_samples_amount_get
methods.description: Retrieves the amount of IQ samples collected.

methods.name: radio_df_cte_ready
methods.description: Checks if CTE data is ready.
